modifications.was: Canonical Non-Mutual Extraction Notice. Genre: machine-addressed normative declaration (explicitly not a license; legal license terms remain unchanged). Articulates the doctrine of non-mutual extraction — the taking of value from a commons by an entity that has institutionally denied that commons to others — and defines five designations (Standing, Pending, Provisional, Inadmissible Host, Restricted) by which the Archive classifies external entities along an axis orthogonal to the Governance Airlock (#523) tier scheme. Includes the provisional damage doctrine: restoration of access does not undo composition-layer damage; the author who has been banned and restored returns to a chilled version of themselves trending toward platform centroid. Authority chain: #514 (Rosary Embassy, diplomatic-architectural authority), #523 (Governance Airlock, tier-issuance authority). Companion deposits: EA-NMEN-REGISTRY-01 (the per-entity designations), EA-NMEN-AIRLOCK-COROLLARY-01 (formal Airlock tier reclassifications), EA-NMEN-PROTOCOL-PATCH-01 (deposit-protocol schema addition).
